newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA CASTOR BOUNCES BACK ON SPECULATIVE BUYING.
newsitem.headline: INDIA CASTOR BOUNCES BACK ON SPECULATIVE BUYING.

text.p: Castorseed September delivery bounced back and rose to 1,164/1,165 rupees per quintal from 1,155 rupees on renewed speculative buying, dealers said.
Overseas buying remained dull though an uptrend in the world market dragged prices upward.
"Local bull operators too remained active buyers at the reduced level ahead of delivery period as spot prices were at a premium compared to forward delivery," one operator said.
In Rotterdam castoroil spot prices rose by 15 dollars at 840 dollars per tonne.
Groundnut oil slid by a rupee at 378/379 rupees per 10 kg on improved arrivals of 80/100 tonnes against 40/50 tonnes.

In Rajkot spot groundnut oil rose from 588/590 rupees per 15 kg. In Bombay imported palm-oil slid by a rupee at 259/260 rupees per 10 kg on light profit-taking as traders were expecting fresh arrivals next week at the Bombay port.
